name: StochRsiK
description: This keyword returns the Stochastic Oscillator value of the K line plotted on RSI. This keyword like all technical indicators are to be used under the Position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the Stochastic Oscillator value of the K line plotted on RSI. This keyword like all technical indicators are to be used under the Position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632145861.png)

The above condition is checking if Previous day(-1)  Stochastic Oscillator value of the D line is greater than Previous day(-1)  Stochastic Oscillator value of the K line both plotted on RSI.

A stochastic oscillator is a popular technical indicator for generating overbought and oversold signals. These indicators are plotted on RSI. Read more about Stock K and D here - https://www.investopedia.com/terms/s/stochasticoscillator.asp
